name: Ride The Tide Surf School
summary: Ride The Tide is a surf school and board rental shop across the road from Freights Bay on the south coast, where the waves are gentle and the bottom is sandy. It started in 2012 as a mobile school run from a van and now has its own shop with showers, changing rooms and lockers. Coaches are in the water with you, with no more than four surfers each.
standouts: Surf shop directly opposite Freights Bay, with changing rooms, freshwater showers and lockers
No more than four surfers per coach
Rental boards from NSP, BIC, Walden and Takayama

contact.address: Enterprise Coast Road, Enterprise, Christ Church, BB17133, Barbados

trips.title: Group Surf Lessons
trips.summary: A small group surf lesson at Freights Bay for beginners and early intermediates, with up to four surfers per coach. It opens with a short beach brief, then coaches stay in the water with you to help pick and catch waves.
highlights: Three lessons every day in the winter season, November to Easter
Coaches in the water with you
Shower, changing room and kit locker at the shop

checkNotes: Prices are shown in Barbados dollars with a US dollar figure beside them; both recorded. Lessons and rentals book through the school's own cart and date picker (built by Caribbean New Media). The About page says most lessons run at Freights Bay and that in summer they move to other breaks when the swell is right; the school's YouTube channel shows summer lessons at Drill Hall. Shop hours 08:30 to 16:00. The contact page form has a captcha (not a block on reading the site). A holiday rental cottage on the site was left out as it is not a marine trip. Cancellation: 72 hours notice for a full refund.
